list.q: Can a bad SMP always be corrected?
list.a: Not always—but we can improve most cases. Our assessment is honest and free.

list.q: Do I need laser removal first?
list.a: In some cases—yes. In others, correction can happen immediately.

list.q: How soon can I get treatment?
list.a: If the SMP is a few weeks old—it might be possible right away. Fresh treatments are best assessed after stabilization.

list.q: Can a new hairline be created?
list.a: Yes—if the skin condition and existing pigment allow.
